name: GitHub: Workflow Jobs with Broad GITHUB_TOKEN Write Permissions
query:
MATCH p=(repo:GH_Repository)-[:GH_Contains]->(:GH_Workflow)-[:GH_Contains]->(job:GH_WorkflowJob)
WHERE 'contents:write' IN job.effective_github_token_permissions
OR 'actions:write' IN job.effective_github_token_permissions
OR 'pull-requests:write' IN job.effective_github_token_permissions
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000
description: Returns workflow jobs whose calculated effective GITHUB_TOKEN permissions include write access to repository contents, Actions, or pull requests. These permissions can materially increase the impact of workflow compromise.
